objective: Independently research two candidate approaches to a design question, then synthesize the findings.

steps.objective: Frame the research question for two independent researchers who will each answer it without seeing each other's work.
expectedOutputs: agent-result.json (status, summary) framing the research question
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report framing the research question

branches.objective: Research approach A independently and report your findings.
expectedOutputs: agent-result.json (status, summary) with verified findings on approach A
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report with verified findings on approach A

branches.objective: Research approach B independently and report your findings.
expectedOutputs: agent-result.json (status, summary) with verified findings on approach B
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report with verified findings on approach B

steps.objective: Synthesize both researchers' independent findings, preserving any disagreement between them.
expectedOutputs: agent-result.json (status, summary) synthesizing both findings without erasing disagreement
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report synthesizing both findings without erasing disagreement
